scope: All 23 numbered manuscript ledger entries inventoried. Selected source checks; not 23 completed external validations.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Greek Hyperboreans and named travellers
entries.assessment: Source tradition identified; exact passages and event dates remain to be collated. Literary identity does not establish biological identity.
source_citations_as_written: Hesiod fragments; Pindar Pythian X; Hecataeus via Diodorus II.47; Herodotus 4.32-36; Pausanias 1.18.5 + 5.7.7-8.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Roman descriptions of northern inhabitants
entries.assessment: Dependency review required: Roman accounts reusing Greek sources cannot supply a fully independent stream.
source_citations_as_written: Pliny Naturalis Historia IV.89-91; Pomponius Mela De Chorographia III.36-37; Strabo Geographica II.5.8 + VII.3.1.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Insular voyage figures as threshold residents
entries.assessment: Primary passage and genre review required; narrative characters have not been independently identified as a historical population.
source_citations_as_written: Selmer 1959 Navigatio Sancti Brendani §28.74-93; Lebor na hUidre Voyage of Mael Dúin; Voyage of Bran (Imram Brain).

entries.claim_paraphrase: Hopi Ant-People as mortal guardians
entries.assessment: Original-language and Hopi-authoritative source review required. The mortal demographic classification is unverified.
source_citations_as_written: Voth 1905 The Traditions of the Hopi (Field Columbian Museum Publication 96); Hopi Cultural Preservation Office continuous oral record; Waters 1963 Book of the Hopi.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Egyptian Akhu and Imy-Duat as a resident population
entries.assessment: Correction required: funerary Akhu include transformed dead; an earthly population does not follow from the terminology.
source_citations_as_written: Pyramid Texts (Faulkner 1969 trans.); Coffin Texts (Faulkner 1973-1978); Amduat NK theological elaboration; Allen 2005 The Ancient Egyptian Pyramid Texts.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Polynesian southern-voyage guardians
entries.assessment: Precise oral source, attribution and interpretation require review; geographic encounters cannot be inferred from motif coding alone.
source_citations_as_written: Smith 1899 Polynesian Society; Wehi et al. 2021 J. Royal Society of NZ (PMC11485871); Maori oral tradition continuous to present.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Uttarakuru and Siddhas as mortal threshold specialists
entries.assessment: Textual chronology and category review required; cross-cultural equivalence remains interpretive.
source_citations_as_written: Mahabharata Sabha Parva 28 + Vana Parva tirtha-yatra section; Ramayana Kishkindha Kanda; Vishnu Purana; Skanda Purana.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Calendar-linked offerings towards Hyperborea
entries.assessment: Correction required: Herodotus 4.33 documents the direction from Hyperborea to Delos. Reverse route and Metonic shipment require separate evidence.
source_citations_as_written: Herodotus Histories 4.32-36; Hecataeus via Diodorus II.47; Pausanias 1.18.5 + 5.7.7-8.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Personnel sent to and retained at thresholds
entries.assessment: Correction required for the Greek route; other examples require separate dated source cards.
source_citations_as_written: Herodotus 4.33 (maidens at Delos); Pausanias 1.18.5 (Olen the Hyperborean poet); Dicuil 825 CE (papar in Iceland); Selmer Navigatio (Brendan); Adomnán Vita Columbae c.700 CE (Cormac).

entries.claim_paraphrase: Ritual offerings as a common exchange system
entries.assessment: Comparative coding hypothesis; distinct funerary, devotional and economic acts must retain their source-specific meanings.
source_citations_as_written: Pyramid Texts (Faulkner 1969); Voth 1905 Hopi tradition; Mahabharata + Skanda Purana; Selmer Navigatio (four-station cycle); Insular monastic Office tradition.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Maintenance of teaching as a shared transaction
entries.assessment: Testable comparative category; a common institution or historical transmission chain is unestablished.
source_citations_as_written: Selmer Navigatio §28.74-93; Voth 1905 Hopi emergence narrative; Iamblichus De Vita Pythagorica 28.140-141; Pyramid Texts; Vedic guru-shishya parampara documented across Upanishads.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Calendrical mathematics supplied by threshold populations
entries.assessment: Evidence for calendar systems must be separated from evidence for the asserted supplier and route.
source_citations_as_written: Hecataeus via Diodorus II.47; Coligny Calendar physical artifact (Musée Gallo-Romain Lyon); Censorinus De Die Natali on the Sothic cycle; Geminus Introduction to the Phenomena.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Northern astronomy as a foundation of mathematical geography
entries.assessment: Passage-by-passage transmission review required; observations, later reports and modern reconstruction need separate dates.
source_citations_as_written: Pytheas via Strabo Geographica + Pliny Naturalis Historia + Geminus + Cleomedes; Eratosthenes via Strabo + Cleomedes; Hipparchus via Ptolemy Almagest.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Abaris transmitting an integrated Pythagorean system
entries.assessment: Later source composition dates and legendary content require explicit handling; historical encounter unverified here.
source_citations_as_written: Iamblichus De Vita Pythagorica 28.140-141; Porphyry Vita Pythagorae 29; Diogenes Laertius VIII; Plato Phaedo + Republic + Timaeus.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Navigation knowledge transmitted through the network
entries.assessment: Correction required: AD 1021 evidence supports Norse presence, not Leif personally. Other links remain unverified.
source_citations_as_written: Selmer Navigatio §22 + §28; Johnston 2014; Grœnlendinga saga + Eiríks saga rauða; Kuitems 2021 Nature 601:388; Smith 1899; Wehi 2021; Imago Mundi (Pierre d'Ailly) Columbus annotations.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Relics, ivory and burials as proof of threshold journeys
entries.assessment: Object provenance and narrative claims need separate treatment; no single provenance category authenticates all examples.
source_citations_as_written: Selmer Navigatio §28.80; Frei et al. 2015 walrus-ivory trade; Herodotus 4.34-35 (maiden-burials at Delos); Pausanias 1.43.4.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Agricultural techniques received from the threshold
entries.assessment: Specific farming evidence may be independently supportable; a common teaching source remains unestablished.
source_citations_as_written: Voth 1905 Hopi tradition; Caulfield et al. 2014 Céide Fields; Church 2013 Quaternary Sci. Reviews; Curtin 2021 Nature Comms Earth & Environ.; Margaryan 2020 Nature 585:390.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Continuous Abaris-to-modern-physics transmission
entries.assessment: Causal genealogy unverified; similarity and later influence do not authenticate the initial Abaris transmission.
source_citations_as_written: Iamblichus + Porphyry (Pythagoras); Plato Phaedo + Republic + Timaeus; Euclid Elements; Apollonius Conics; Archimedes; Kepler Mysterium + Harmonices Mundi; Newton Principia.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Brendan/Vinland knowledge contributing to Columbus
entries.assessment: Exact annotated manuscript folios and intermediate links required; known Norse presence does not establish the proposed whole chain.
source_citations_as_written: Selmer 1959 Navigatio (125+ surviving manuscripts); Pierre d'Ailly Imago Mundi (Columbus's annotated copy in Biblioteca Colombina); Hauksbók manuscript; Kuitems et al. 2021 Nature 601:388.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Coligny mathematics surviving through Easter and Gregorian reform
entries.assessment: Chronological and technical source audit required; common calendrical cycles do not demonstrate that route of transmission.
source_citations_as_written: Coligny Calendar physical artifact (Musée Gallo-Romain Lyon); Council of Nicaea 325 CE Easter calculation; Gregorian calendar reform 1582; Olmsted 1992 Gaulish Calendar; Le Contel & Verdier 1997.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Vedic threshold teaching as ancestor of modern practices and numerals
entries.assessment: Distinct mathematical and religious histories must be traced separately; shared threshold origin unverified.
source_citations_as_written: Yoga Sutras of Patanjali; Hatha Yoga Pradipika; Brahmagupta + Aryabhata + Kerala-school mathematics; Kabat-Zinn 1990 Full Catastrophe Living; peer-reviewed yoga-and-meditation clinical literature.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Hopi continuity as an uninterrupted control case
entries.assessment: The proposed control design and claim of no major disruption are unverified; requires Hopi-authoritative context and an independent comparison design.
source_citations_as_written: Voth 1905; Hopi Cultural Preservation Office continuous documentation; Waters 1963 Book of the Hopi; Whiteley 1988 Deliberate Acts; ongoing Hopi tribal documentation.

entries.claim_paraphrase: Egyptian threshold tradition as foundation of modern timekeeping
entries.assessment: Separate documented technical influences from the claimed threshold-population source; full causal chain unverified.
source_citations_as_written: Pyramid Texts; Censorinus De Die Natali (Sothic cycle); Ptolemy Almagest; al-Battani + al-Tusi; Toledan + Alfonsine Tables; Copernicus De Revolutionibus 1543.
